Name: Seasonal Cute Characters for East Scarp
Author: Poltergeister
Description:
Welcome!

This mod adds seasonal outfits for the characters featured in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]. Add-ons for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6398]Juliet and Jessie the Joja Clerks[/url] , [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599]Professor Jasper Thomas[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9642]the last Smoluanu[/url] are available. Additionally, this mod edits the overall appearances of the characters as showcased in the picture section. The mod is meant to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿ for a consistent look but it’s not a requirement.
Just like in my other mods, only outfits for Spirit's Eve and Flower Dance are available for festivals. [b]This means if the characters have outfits for additional festivals natively, my mod will override them with their basic seasonal version.[/b] If you do not want this, turn changes for the character off in the config.
[size=5][b]I will not change or add outfits[/b][b], portraits or sprites for characters already in the mod[/b][b]![/b][/size]

Configs

NoNose": "[b]True[/b], False"
This decides if the character sprites have noses or not. Set it to "false" if you want the characters to have noses.

"FestivalOutfits": "[b]True[/b], False"
Decides if characters will wear Flower Dance and Spirit's Eve outfits.

"CuteX": "[b]True[/b], False"
Decides if a character will be affected by the mod or not. Example: Set "CuteAideen" to false if you don't wish to use their cute
version. Neither portrait nor sprite will now be loaded.

"ExtraNPC": "[b]True[/b], False"
NPCs in events

I hope you enjoy this mod!
